mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('FAULT:', D.DSBLTY_NO) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, 'FAULT' AS CATEGORY_CD, '고장' AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD IN ('EMERGENCY','CRITICAL','HIGH') THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD IN ('WARNING','CAUTION','MEDIUM') THEN 'CAUTION' ELSE D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD END AS SEVERITY_CD, CONCAT(COALESCE(S.STN_NM, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM, '설비'), ' 장애 알림') AS TITLE, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS MESSAGE, CONCAT(COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM, 'TNMS'), CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_NM IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' · ', E.EQPMNT_NM) END) AS SOURCE_NAME, D.DSBLTY_NO AS REF_KEY, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/fault/realtime.do?screen=faults' AS TARGET_URL FROM dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN = D.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD = E.STN_CD LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD = E.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE D.EXCP_APLY_YN = 'N' AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ACCOUNT:', A.APLY_NO) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, 'ACCOUNT' AS CATEGORY_CD, '계정신청' AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE WHEN A.APLY_STTS_CD = 'REJECTED' THEN 'CAUTION' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS SEVERITY_CD, CASE A.APLY_STTS_CD WHEN 'WAITING' THEN '신규 계정 신청' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '계정 신청 승인 완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '계정 신청 반려' ELSE '계정 신청 상태 변경' END AS TITLE, CONCAT(A.USER_NM, ' (', A.USER_ID, ') · ', COALESCE(A.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, '-'), CASE WHEN A.DEPT_NM IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' / ', A.DEPT_NM) END) AS MESSAGE, COALESCE(A.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, '계정관리') AS SOURCE_NAME, A.APLY_NO AS REF_KEY, COALESCE(A.APRV_DT, A.APLY_DT) AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/user/list.do?screen=users' AS TARGET_URL FROM user_acnt_aply_info A WHERE A.APLY_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('OP:', J.JOB_LOG_SN) AS NOTIFICATION_ID, CASE WHEN J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%권한%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%공통코드%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%설정%' THEN 'SETTING' ELSE 'OPERATION' END AS CATEGORY_CD, CASE WHEN J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%권한%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%공통코드%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%설정%' THEN '설정' ELSE '운영관리' END AS CATEGORY_NM, CASE WHEN J.JOB_RSLT_CD = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'CRITICAL' END AS SEVERITY_CD, CASE WHEN J.JOB_RSLT_CD = 'SUCCESS' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(J.CNTN_MENU_NM, '운영관리'), ' 작업 완료') ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(J.CNTN_MENU_NM, '운영관리'), ' 작업 실패') END AS TITLE, COALESCE(J.LOG_CN, J.TRGT_KEY_VL, '작업 이력이 등록되었습니다.') AS MESSAGE, CONCAT(COALESCE(J.USER_ID, 'SYSTEM'), ' · ', COALESCE(J.USER_IP_ADDR, '-')) AS SOURCE_NAME, CAST(J.JOB_LOG_SN AS CHAR) AS REF_KEY, J.LOG_CRT_DT AS EVENT_DT_RAW, '/audit/job-log.do?screen=logs' AS TARGET_URL FROM job_log J WHERE J.LOG_CRT_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND (J.JOB_RSLT_CD <> 'SUCCESS' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%권한%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%계정%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%공통코드%' OR J.CNTN_MENU_NM LIKE '%설정%')
mapper.select:
SELECT N.NOTIFICATION_ID, N.CATEGORY_CD, N.CATEGORY_NM, N.SEVERITY_CD, N.TITLE, N.MESSAGE, N.SOURCE_NAME, N.REF_KEY, DATE_FORMAT(N.EVENT_DT_RAW, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS EVENT_DT, N.TARGET_URL, CASE WHEN R.USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS READ_YN, DATE_FORMAT(R.READ_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS READ_DT FROM (
) N LEFT JOIN user_ntcn_read_info R ON R.USER_ID = #{_parameter} AND R.NTCN_ID = N.NOTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY N.EVENT_DT_RAW DESC, N.NOTIFICATION_ID DESC LIMIT 60
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_ntcn_read_info (USER_ID, NTCN_ID, READ_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notificationId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE READ_DT = VALUES(READ_DT)
